tools.name: get_mf_holdings
tools.description: Get all mutual fund holdings for a client: scheme name, units, NAV, current value, gain/loss percentage.

tools.name: get_sip_schedule
tools.description: Get active SIP mandates for a client: fund name, monthly amount, next debit date, expiry date. Flags SIPs expiring within 30 days.

tools.name: get_loan_summary
tools.description: Get all active loans for a client: type, outstanding amount, EMI, next due date, LTV ratio, overdue days.

tools.name: get_demat_holdings
tools.description: Get stock/demat holdings for a client: company, ISIN, quantity, buy price, current price, unrealized P&L.

tools.name: get_clients_with_expiring_sips
tools.description: Get all clients of an RM whose SIPs are expiring within the specified number of days.

tools.name: get_live_nav
tools.description: Get live NAV and returns (1Y/3Y/5Y) for a mutual fund from AMFI via AWS AgentCore.

tools.name: get_live_stock_price
tools.description: Get live stock price, day change, 52-week range for an NSE/BSE listed stock via AWS AgentCore.

tools.name: get_market_indices
tools.description: Get current values and day change for major Indian market indices: Nifty 50, Sensex, Nifty Bank, Nifty IT.
